case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. sup:70140.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
sup:70140.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a long-term partner, and that is the right starting point. Our options are built around steady work for you, with a quality commitment that makes each delivery count.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 63.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 39.85.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.18.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.41.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you a clear quality target and a fixed price per unit with no chargeback, and it fits what our history with you shows on delivery and price. The three options differ only in the quality level, so you can pick the one that suits your foundry best.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. 

Since payments sometimes take a while, maybe we can talk about bigger volumes to balance things out? Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Our offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer is valid for 30 days.

We can also offer an alternative: a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. We can do the 1500 ppm target from Option A, but we need EUR 46.50 per unit.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
